$comment: VAPP-103: the input LIMITS every core enforces (the TS reference, the Rust core and through it Swift, Compose and gpui). An agent's input past a limit is refused with an issue, never worked on. `maxComponents` = nodes the reducer places in one surface's tree, template nodes included (the rest is dropped: `surface: more than N components; the rest is dropped`). `maxDepth` = component nesting levels, the root = 1 (a deeper node is the Unknown placeholder: `nesting deeper than N levels`); 64 keeps a laid-out surface (macro parts nest up to 4 boxes per Card, taffy recurses per box) inside an iOS secondary thread's 512 KB stack with room to spare, and serde_json's default recursion limit (128) already caps the NESTED form near 64 nodes. `maxMessageBytes` = one server message as UTF-8 JSON (host routers refuse it: INVALID_MESSAGE). `maxTemplateItems` = template items one surface instantiates (beyond it the items are not rendered: `template: more than N items; the rest is not rendered`). `maxPointerBytes` / `maxPointerSegments` = a data pointer's length and token count (a longer write is refused). Generated into every target; src/limits.ts reads it.
